newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish, Dutch prime ministers meet to discuss EU.
newsitem.headline: Irish, Dutch prime ministers meet to discuss EU.

text.p: Irish Prime Minister John Bruton met his Dutch counterpart Willem Kok in Dublin on Thursday to discuss European Union issues ahead of Ireland's handover of the EU presidency to the Netherlands on January 1.

Bruton said they had discussed the agenda for December's heads-of-state summit in Dublin, as well as employment policy, arrangements for the single European currency and the work of the inter-governmental conference (IGC), the EU's review of the way it works.
"The two governments see eye-to-eye on most issues," Bruton told reporters.
Kok said he had congratulated the Irish presidency for the work it had done in "bringing the IGC negotiations forward successfully".
